package.desc: Provides logical symbols, proof circuits, and proof checking.
package.title: Logic and proofs

ui.assume 只能假设要证的「若…则…」的前一半: assume can only assume the “if” part of what is to be proved
ui.fix 只能用在要证「对所有」的时候: fix only works when “for all” is to be proved
ui.show 了要证的那句以后，不能再写: Nothing may follow the show of what is to be proved
ui.using 里有一个名字还不在这里: A name used is not available here
ui.{depth} 层以内都搜遍了，也没有证完: Searched everything within {depth} levels without finishing
ui.{value} 不受 ∀ 或 ∃ 约束：它指的是什么？: {value} is not bound by ∀ or ∃: what does it refer to?
ui.{value}：{X} 出现在另一边里面，代进去永远代不完: {value}: {X} occurs inside the other side, and putting it in never ends
ui.{value}：{X} 是在取出 {value2} 之前留下的，不能变成后来才有: {value}: {X} was left before {value2} was taken, and cannot become something that came later
ui.{value}：{name} 后面跟的不都是不同的约束变量，解不止一个，证明助手: {value}: {name} is not applied to distinct bound variables, so there is more than one solution, and the proof assistant does not guess
ui.{value}：{value2} 是量词管着的，{X} 不能带走它: {value}: {value2} is bound by a quantifier, and {X} cannot take it out
ui.{value}：两边的样子不同，怎样代都对不上: {value}: the two sides have different shapes, and nothing put in makes them meet
ui.φ 里 s 出现的每一处: Each place s stands in φ
ui.「{kind}」玩法，harness 还不支持: a “{kind}” play; the harness does not cover it yet
ui.「{value}」还不是子句：已知要先化成合取范式: “{value}” is not a clause yet: bring the hypotheses to CNF first
ui.「{zh}」的左边在第一个目标的已知里哪一处都对不上: The left side of “{zh}” fits nowhere in the first goal’s hypotheses
ui.「{zh}」的左边在第一个目标里哪一处都对不上: The left side of “{zh}” fits nowhere in the first goal
ui.「{zh}」的结论对不上第一个目标：{zh2}: The conclusion of “{zh}” does not fit the first goal: {zh2}
ui.一个元件：词汇表里的元件，或 game.json 里的引理、门、等式: a part: one of the vocabulary’s, or a lemma, gate or equation of game.json
ui.一份声明：每条引入规则一行，取的东西和前提（规则表的写法）: a declaration: one introduction rule a row, the things it takes and its premises (as the rule table writes it)
ui.一句话，按 formula.js 的写法：Rain → Wet、∀x. Huma: a sentence as formula.js reads it: Rain → Wet, ∀x. Human(x), ?A ∧ ?B
ui.一张图（或几张）进，按一条规则算出的图出: a picture (or a few) in, the picture a rule makes of them out
ui.一条子句（几个字母或它们的否定用「或」连起来）: a clause (letters or their negations joined by or)
ui.一直推出新子句，停不下来: New clauses keep coming: it never stops
ui.从上方元件栏选择元件放到板上，从「输入」连到「结果」。: Place parts from the bar above and wire them from Input to Result.
ui.从上方元件栏选择规则放到板上，再把元件右侧的圆点连到另一元件左侧的圆点。: Place a rule from the bar above, then connect a dot on the right of one part to a dot on the left of another.
ui.从上方元件栏选择门放到板上，再把元件右侧的圆点连到另一元件左侧的圆点。: Place a gate from the bar above, then connect a dot on the right of one part to a dot on the left of another.
ui.任取框：框里证 P(a)，得到 ∀x. P(x): For-any box: prove P(a) inside, get ∀x. P(x)
ui.假设框：框里假设 A 证出 B，得到 A → B: Assumption box: assume A inside, prove B, get A → B
ui.写脚本：一行一句，by 后面是证法: writing a script: a row a statement, each with its by
ui.分类讨论：由 A ∨ B 和两个框得到 C: Case analysis: from A ∨ B and two boxes, C
ui.前提「{zh}」在这个世界里不成立。: The premise “{zh}” does not hold in this world.
ui.前提都成立，结论不成立：这个世界是反例。: Every premise holds and the goal fails: this world is a counterexample.
ui.化简完了，两边还不一样: Simplified, and the two sides still differ
ui.参考解里预先放在板上的元件（锁住）: cards of the reference answer the board starts with, locked
ui.取一个这里还没用过的名字: Pick a name not used here yet
ui.变成测试列出的几种结果（每种是它的目标）；一种也没有：这一步失败: the results the test lists, each its goals; none: the step fails
ui.可推导情形 {row} 使用了这一关未提供的任取设置。: Row {row} uses a “for any” this task does not offer.
ui.可推导情形 {row} 的第 {slot} 个前提提到了没有任取的东西。: Row {row}, premise {slot}: names a thing the row does not take.
ui.可推导情形 {row} 的第 {slot} 个前提用了这一关未提供的词：{val: Row {row}, premise {slot}: uses words not on offer: {value}.
ui.各条条例的预期都正确，但这份声明在每一条上都得出了正确结论，还没有暴露它的错误。: Every expectation is correct, but this declaration reaches the right conclusion on every case: its fault has not yet been revealed.
ui.在下面的世界中，你写的句子为真，原句却为假：: In this world your sentence is true but the original is false:
ui.在下面的世界中，原句为真，你写的句子却为假：: In this world the original is true but your sentence is false:
ui.在每个小世界中，真假都与原句一致。: In every small world it has the same truth value as the original.
ui.在这个世界里，两份译文都为{zh}：真假一致。: In this world both translations are {zh}: they agree.
ui.在这个世界里，译文和原意真假不同：这个世界是反例。: In this world the translation and what was meant differ: this world is a counterexample.
ui.套用：由 A → B 和 A 得到 B: Apply: from A → B and A, B
ui.子句里还没有 ⊥：没有证书可以重放: There is no ⊥ among the clauses: no certificate to replay
ui.存在一个命题，使得: there is a proposition such that
ui.存在一种性质，使得: there is a property such that
ui.定义：给每一行选一个右边: a definition: a right side picked for every row
ui.实例框：由 ∃x. P(x) 和框得到 C: Witness box: from ∃x. P(x) and a box, C
ui.已找出错误：这份声明在第 {value} 条条例上得出错误结论。: Fault found: this declaration gets case {value} wrong.
ui.已找到反例：命题在这一行为假。: Counterexample found: the proposition is false on this row.
ui.已找到满足赋值：命题在这一行为真。: Satisfying assignment found: the proposition is true on this row.
ui.已知里有 ∀ 底下换成的 Skolem 函数：它不是已知推出来的，核里重放不了: The hypotheses have a Skolem function put in under ∀: it does not follow from them, so the kernel cannot replay it
ui.已知里的等式只用来改目标: An equation given rewrites only the goal
ui.已知里还有 ∃：先 Skolem 化: A hypothesis still has ∃: Skolemise first
ui.引理：照证出它的那段证明来推: A lemma: runs the proof that proved it
ui.归纳的某一种情况没有证完: A case of the induction is not finished
ui.归结：两条子句消去一对文字: Resolution: cancel one pair of literals
ui.得到的目标和要的不一样: The goals made are not the ones wanted
ui.所有测试都正确，但用了 {steps} 张卡，这一关最多允许 {budget}: Every test is correct, but the board uses {steps} cards; this level allows {budget}.
ui.找出所有答案：?-字母取到的每一种: every answer: each thing its ?-letters can become
ui.找到的答案是 {value}，应该是 {value2}: The answers found are {value}; they should be {value2}
ui.把每条引入规则逆用于第一个目标：拼接、假设框、补充的左右两条、任取框、概括。每条: Applies every introduction rule backwards to the first goal: Join, the assumption box, Add alternative left and right, the for-any box, Generalise. Each rule that fits gives one result.
ui.把每条消去规则用于已知：拆解、分类讨论、套用「若…则…」、爆炸、实例框，以及选定: Applies every elimination rule to the hypotheses: Split, Case analysis, applying an “if”, Explosion, the instance box, and choose an instance then use it. Each fit gives one result.
ui.拆出的子句和要的不一样: The clauses made are not the ones wanted
ui.拆解：由 A ∧ B 得到 A、B: Split: from A ∧ B, A and B
ui.拼接：由 A 和 B 得到 A ∧ B: Join: from A and B, A ∧ B
ui.按照下方脚本连接证明。: Wire the proof shown in the script below.
ui.接入一份声明（所声明的句子和它的引入规则列表），输出这份声明的消去规则。: Wire in a declaration (the declared sentence and its list of introduction rules); gives the declaration’s elimination rule.
ui.接入一条规则。规则以约束变量开头（⋀x. …）时，框内处理其后的规则，输出时在结: Wire in a rule. If it begins with bound variables (⋀x. …), the frame works on the rule after them, and the output keeps the same bound variables in front; if it has none, the frame works on the input itself.
ui.接入一条规则和一句话：保留规则的前提，结论换成这句话。: Wire in a rule and a sentence: keeps the rule’s premises and makes the sentence its conclusion.
ui.接入其他规则元件时，本元件的规则排在它们之后。: When other rule parts are wired in, its rules come after theirs.
ui.接着上一个任务的电路往下做: goes on from the last task’s board
ui.推出 ⊥ 用了 {length} 条子句，最多只能有 {budget} 条: Reaching ⊥ took {length} clauses; at most {budget} are allowed
ui.推出空子句 ⊥（测试有预算时，子句不超过预算）: the empty clause ⊥ (within the test’s budget of clauses)
ui.推导出了「{zh}」，但用到的引入规则没有用上前提{value}。: “{zh}” is derived, but by an intro rule that does not take the premise {value}.
ui.搜了 {LIMIT} 步还没停下来：有一条路走不到头: Searched {LIMIT} steps without stopping: one path never ends
ui.改了 {limit} 次还没停下来：有几条规则把句子改来改去: Still changing after {limit} rewrites: some rules turn the sentence back and forth
ui.最后一个测试（字母）里，这些词怎么读: how these words read in the last test, the letters
ui.查询：拼一句带 x 的话，在每个世界里选中答案: a query: a sentence with x that picks out the answers in every world
ui.核已检查每一行。证明完毕。: The kernel has checked every row. Q.E.D.
ui.每一条条例的预期都符合需求，这份声明的结果也都和预期相符。: Every expectation meets the requirement, and this declaration’s results all agree with them.
ui.每一条条例的预期都符合需求，这份声明的结果都和预期不符。: Every expectation meets the requirement, and this declaration’s results all disagree with them.
ui.每一行的右边都须写完: Every row needs a whole right side
ui.每一行都正确，但用了 {gates} 个门，这一关最多允许 {budget} 个: Every row is correct, but it uses {gates} gates; this level allows {budget}.
ui.每一行都正确：这块电路算出了这句话的完整真值表。: Every row is correct: this circuit computes the sentence’s full truth table.
ui.每个值都正确，每次递归调用的参数都更小，因此这条定义必定终止。: Every value is correct and every recursive call is on a smaller argument, so this definition always terminates.
ui.每个谓词对哪些东西成立（一样东西，或几样一组）: what each predicate holds of (a thing, or a tuple of things)
ui.每条条例都正确，但引入规则与要求不符：{value}: Every test case is right, but the intro rules are not the ones asked for: {value}
ui.每次递归调用的参数都更小: Every recursive call is on a smaller argument
ui.每组测试把字母换成哪些句子: the sentences each test puts in place of the letters
ui.深度优先搜索，直到证完：每一步依次尝试由假设得证、分解目标、分解假设；回到原状态: Searches depth first until done: each step tries Assumption, then Goal apart, then Use a given; a path back to an earlier state is not followed.
ui.点按一条条例即可修改。: Tap a test case to edit it.
ui.生成的规则和这份声明的消去规则不一样: The rule made is not this declaration’s elimination rule
ui.用条例检验别人的声明: checking someone’s declarations by test cases
ui.由前提（列表或单项）和结论构造规则 ⟦前提⟧ ⟹ 结论。句子直接作为前提；规则成: Builds the rule ⟦premises⟧ ⟹ conclusion from premises (a list or a single item) and a conclusion. A sentence is a premise as it is; a rule becomes a premise with its own assumptions.
ui.由矛盾 ⊥ 得到元件上选定的任意一句。: From the contradiction ⊥, gives whatever sentence is chosen on the part.
ui.目标的已知里，没有一条等式或等价对得上第一个目标的哪一处: No equation or equivalence among the hypotheses fits anywhere in the first goal
ui.真值电路：一块门电路在真值表的每一行上跑: a truth circuit: a board of gates run on every row of a truth table
ui.真值表（逐行手填或勾选），harness 还不支持: a truth table (rows ticked by hand); the harness does not cover it yet
ui.真值表：一行一行填: a truth table, filled in row by row
ui.第 {k} 条条例上，这份声明的结果与预期不符。: On case {k}, this declaration’s result disagrees with the expectation.
ui.第 {k} 条条例上，这份声明的结果与预期相符，没有暴露它的错误。: On case {k}, this declaration’s result agrees with the expectation and does not reveal its fault.
ui.第 {k} 条条例的预期与需求不符。请重新考虑：{zh}时，按需求「{zh2}」: The expectation of case {k} does not agree with the requirement. Reconsider: {zh}, is “{zh2}” derivable according to the requirement?
ui.第 {k} 条条例还没有选预期结果。: Case {k} has no expected result yet.
ui.第 {k} 条条例：按需求，{zh}时「{zh2}」{zh3}，和这一条的预期不: Case {k}: according to the requirement, {zh}, “{zh2}” is {zh3}, unlike this case’s expectation. Rewrite the part of it left for you.
ui.第 {n} 种结果的目标和要的不一样: Result {n} has other goals than wanted
ui.第 {row} 行的右边又用到了这个函数，可拆的那个参数没有变小：这样的定义可能: Row {row} calls the function again on an argument that is no smaller: such a definition may never finish
ui.第一个目标和哪一条已知都对不上: The first goal fits none of its hypotheses
ui.第一个目标还不是 ⊥：先把要证的那句否定了放进已知: The first goal is not ⊥ yet: negate what is to be proved and put it among the hypotheses first
ui.等式的一边：一样东西或一句话（schematic.js）: a side of an equation: a thing or a sentence (schematic.js)
ui.等量代换：由 s = t 和 φ(s) 得到 φ(t): Rewrite: from s = t and φ(s), φ(t)
ui.算 {zh}，{BUDGET} 步还没算完: Working out {zh}, {BUDGET} steps did not finish
ui.结果代回去，原来的等式两边还不一样: Put back into the equations, the result does not make both sides equal
ui.结果要一个证明状态: The result must be a proof state
ui.结果要一条规则，接进来的是{zh}: The result must be a rule; it got {zh}
ui.结果要一组子句: The result must be a clause set
ui.结果要一组等式: The result must be a set of equations
ui.结果还能再归结出新子句：还没饱和: The result still resolves into new clauses: not saturated yet
ui.结果里有 ⊥，可这组子句是可满足的：证明助手「证」出了假话: The result holds ⊥, yet these clauses can all hold: the proof assistant “proved” something false
ui.结果里还没有空子句 ⊥: The result has no empty clause ⊥ yet
ui.结论「{zh}」在这个世界里也成立，这个世界不是反例。: The goal “{zh}” holds in this world too: it is no counterexample.
ui.给出这一关的数与列表规则：类型声明生成的规则、定义中的等式和已证出的等式。在元件: Gives this level’s rules for numbers and lists: those generated by its type declarations, its definitions’ equations and the equations proved so far. Add the ones to give on the part; they keep the order added.
ui.给出这个元件的规则。在元件上添加要给出的规则，按添加顺序排列。: Gives this part’s rules. Add the ones to give on the part; they keep the order added.
ui.翻译：把一句话拼成公式: translating: a sentence built as a formula
ui.能代入的东西或句子: Things or sentences to put in
ui.能推出 ⊥ 时推出 ⊥；否则饱和至不再产生新子句: ⊥ if it follows; otherwise saturation, with no new clause left
ui.补充：由 A 得到 A ∨ B: Add alternative: from A, A ∨ B
ui.要找出所有答案，可搜索停不下来：有一条路走不到头: Every answer is wanted, but the search never stops: one path never ends
ui.规则元件能给出的规则: The rules a rule part can give
ui.规则元件：给出它的规则: A rule part: the rules it gives
ui.规则板：声明一个连接词的引入规则，或用条例检验别人的声明: the rule board: a connective’s introduction rules declared, or someone’s declaration checked by cases
ui.规则用上了，可它的前提不全在 using 的事实里: The rule applies, but its premises are not all among the facts used
ui.解完的等式（能合一时），或者「失败」（不能时）: the solved equations (when they unify), or “failed” (when not)
ui.解完的等式（能合一时），或者失败: the solved equations (when they unify), or a failure
ui.证不出时停下，报告证不出: to stop and report failure when the goal cannot be proved
ui.证不出时停止，并报告证不出: to stop and report failure when it cannot be proved
ui.证明助手：机器板上的一块电路，处理每组测试的输入: a proof assistant: a machine board run on every test’s input
ui.证明器：从这一代起，每一章给它加一个模块: the prover: from this era on, each chapter adds a module to it
ui.证明板：规则即元件，从已知接到目标: the proof board: rules as parts, wired from the givens to the goal
ui.还有空位：句子的每个位置都须填写。: Some slots are still empty; every slot must be filled.
ui.还没有 show 要证的那一句: What is to be proved is not shown yet
ui.还没有条例。请添加一条，写明情形、结论，以及结论是否应当可推导。: No cases yet. Add one: its premises, a conclusion, and whether it should be derivable.
ui.还没解完：要每个等式左边都是一个 ?，右边里没有这些 ?: Not solved yet: each equation must have a ?-letter on the left, and none of those letters on any right side
ui.这一关不给的元件（一段证明不许用框）: parts the level holds back (a proof without boxes)
ui.这一关新带来的元件: the parts this level brings in
ui.这一关没有这条规则: This level has no such rule
ui.这一关的名字（特定的东西）: the names (particular things) the level reads
ui.这一关自带的规则（元件）: rules the level states, each a part
ui.这一句不是那句「存在」说的 {value}: This is not what the “there is” says of {value}
ui.这一句证不出来，证明助手却还没有说「证不出来」: This cannot be proved, yet the proof assistant has not said so
ui.这一步应该做不了，证明助手却做了: This step should not apply, yet the proof assistant did it
ui.这一行的结果错误，运行停在这里。板上每个元件显示它在这一行算出的值。: This row is wrong; the run stopped here. Each part on the board shows its value on this row.
ui.这一行的结果错误：电路输出 {value}{value2}。: This row is wrong: the circuit outputs {value}{value2}.
ui.这个世界里的东西太多。: This world has too many things.
ui.这个任务证出的等式进规则书时的样子（不写就是等式本身）: how the equation this task proves enters the rule book (when not said, the equation itself)
ui.这个名字只在它绑定的区域里可用。: This name is only available inside the region that binds it.
ui.这组子句不是从证明状态拆出来的，没有可以证的目标: These clauses were not split from a proof state: there is no goal to prove
ui.这组等式其实合一不了，结果却没有说「失败」: These equations have no unifier, yet the result does not say it failed
ui.这组等式能合一，结果却说失败了: These equations can be unified, yet the result says it failed
ui.这里要 show 的是「{value}」: What is to be shown here is “{value}”
ui.这里须填入一样东西：名字或变量。: This slot takes a thing: a name or a variable.
ui.选定一例后再使用: Choose an instance, then use it
ui.选定一例：由 ∀x. P(x) 得到 P(t): Choose an instance: from ∀x. P(x), P(t)
ui.通关后的一句（只说这一关，不剧透做法）: the pass text (this level only, never the way it is solved)
ui.造世界：让句子真假如所要: building a world in which the sentences come out as asked
